executive_summary: Episode 106 advances three threads: (1) Candace displays a trailer for an upcoming Hunter Biden interview airing Thursday, with Hunter making on-camera admissions and comments about Charlie Kirk; (2) the Erika Kirk CEO-appointment Aspen video controversy escalates as a Daily Mail piece by Charlie Spearing claims exclusive screening while turning Point cites donor privacy for non-release; (3) Candace tests the White House denial of the WHCD email, receives an identical 4.5-minute denial, then gets ghosted on a clarifying follow-up. Paramount Tactical's two September 2025 DOD contracts totaling $190k are surfaced.
